title: pricing.charge_model
description: Price one bucket's aggregation with a charge model (BE-PR-1..42). amount is UNROUNDED (major units); unit_amount = amount per unit (model-specific denominator); amount_details in stored JSON form (decimals as strings). With aggregation.groups and pricing_group_keys, each group is priced independently and `groups` lists them (amount and units are the sums). A reference crash is the domain error charge_model_error.

properties.description: Charge (or matched filter) properties as stored: string keys, JSON numbers kept as given.

premium.description: Premium licence active (enables graduated_percentage, per-transaction min/max, pricing units, minimum amounts).

period_ratio.description: Elapsed fraction of the period used by projections.

flags.description: Pay-in-advance baseline flags set by the delta computation (BE-PR-43/44).

units.description: Aggregated units U of the bucket (after metric rounding; prorated when the charge is prorated).

count.description: Number of events C in the bucket.

full_units_number.description: Units without proration (FU); absent = not provided by the aggregation.
full_units_number.x-kit-absent: no full-units figure; formulas use units

current_usage_units.description: Units reported for current usage (pay-in-advance / prorated charges).

running_total.description: Running totals of event values in timestamp order, as produced by the aggregation for the percentage model's free units (aggregation chapter BE-AG-20). Kit inputs keep it consistent with per_event_values (the corrected per-transaction walk of BE-PR-30 relies on it).

per_event_values.description: Per-event values in timestamp order (percentage per-transaction mode). Pay in advance: the current persisted event is the LAST element.

event_value.description: Value of the not-yet-stored event (pay-in-advance estimate only).

per_event_full.description: Prorated graduated: signed unit change of each event (full units).
per_event_full.x-kit-absent: no per-event data; a prorated graduated charge then prices as plain graduated

per_event_prorated.description: Prorated graduated: the same changes weighted by the remaining fraction of the period.

precise_total_amount_cents.description: Dynamic model: sum of the events' precise_total_amount_cents (minor units).

custom_amount.description: Custom model: amount computed by the custom aggregation (major units).

grouped_by.description: Group key values of this group (pricing group keys -> value or null).
